name: nested-capture-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.nested-capture.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test core/proof-output.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts research/bapa/proof-capture.test.ts research/bapa/proof-codec.test.ts research/bapa/proof-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/nested-capture-smoke.ts on > "$OUT/on.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/nested-capture-smoke.ts off > "$OUT/off.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/nested-capture-smoke.ts compare > "$OUT/parity.json" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'fix(bapa): publish only outer proof capture events' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
